changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: The exact TP4 contract is unsupported on the current one- or two-Spark configuration. Half of the immutable 405,518,511,891-byte snapshot is already 202.8 GB per rank before KV cache and runtime memory, so no safe TP2 variant can fit the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The superseded TP4 contract remains installable; the 126 GB-envelope GLM 5.3 EXL3 DFlash2 TP2 recipe is the current alternative.
changes.summary: Recorded the exact TP2 checkpoint lower bound and the fleet-fit GLM alternative.

changes.details: The archived upstream directs new four-node installations to its canonical DFlash successor. The immutable executable contract remains published solely for release reproducibility; runtime and artifacts are unchanged.
changes.summary: Marked the historical TP4 recipe superseded and unavailable on the two-Spark fleet.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
Switched to the public digest-pinned ARM64 image with matched sparse-MLA kernels, B12X GLM score mode, and the MTP indexer fix baked in.
Adopted upstream's 128K, four-sequence, MTP-k4 profile with FP8 DSA KV allocation, FULL CUDA graphs, GLM reasoning, and sparse-MLA controls.
Moved NCCL 2.30.4 into the adapter build using the exact PyPI ARM64 wheel and SHA-256 so serving requires no host-staged libraries or kernel mounts.
Added build-time fail-closed checks for every required kernel file and patch marker. Candidate status now denotes only the pending physical canary.
Aligned TP4 memory, sparse-MTP, batching, executor, CUDA graph, and NCCL settings while recording the missing upstream kernel bake.
Initial reviewed catalog release of GLM 5.2 QuantTrio four Sparks.
